title:
Live music
in the crowd
show_h: The party comes down off the stage
show_p: VENDAVAL Brass is a brass and percussion band that plays in the middle of the audience. In this format, the band sets up on the square in front of the music stage and turns the wait between concerts into a party.

Six musicians in sea-creature costumes and theatrical make-up play funk, Balkan, swing and cumbia, conducted live with hand signs. Two fantastical characters, one on stilts and one on a unicycle, get the audience skipping, throwing soft objects into the air and dancing together. The band can go up on stage, but most of the action happens in the crowd.
box: Built for stage changeovers: the audience stays, plays and dances while the next band sets up.
30 minutes, several sets a day. For all ages, day or night.
On the square in front of the stage; the band can go up on stage. The stilt-walker always stays in the crowd, unless the stage is low.
6 musicians (3 saxophones, trumpet, sousaphone, percussion) and 2 circus artists (stilts, unicycle, juggling, games).
Amplified: 8 wireless mics (6 instrument, 2 voice) into the festival PA, or fully acoustic, without mics.
No dialogue; game instructions in English, German, Catalan or Spanish.
mus_p1: Every piece is an original VENDAVAL composition. The music the band members have brought from Europe and the Americas blends into an open repertoire:
mus_p2: From the middle of the square, the conductor uses hand signs to call a change of rhythm, a solo, or a pause for a game. Every set is different: the music responds to the people in front of it.
chr_p: Every musician is a character: sailors, sirens and creatures of the deep, with bold theatrical make-up and costumes in all the colours of the sea. It's an extra layer of theatre on top of a live concert, made to be seen from near and far.
The audience games use skipping ropes, soft objects to throw into the air, the sea net and the lifebuoy.
why_h: The square as a shared dance floor
why_p: A square full of music is a place where strangers end up dancing together. Between concerts, VENDAVAL opens up a space for spontaneous play: skipping with someone you've just met, laughing with a sea creature on stilts, applauding a melody born on the spot.
Shared play is open-air therapy, free and collective, that breaks through loneliness. And the colours of the sea —blues, greens, oranges and pinks— fill the square with life.
acc_p: VENDAVAL wants to reach everyone. The company offers a tactile visit for blind and partially sighted people. Because this format is amplified, it's easier to add audio description, hearing loops and vibrating backpacks, if the organiser has the equipment.
ducs: For more on including differently abled people in circus, see DUCS: Diseño universal del circo social.

dl: Dossiers, technical riders and photos: www.VENDAVAL.cat/descarregues
s1: Flat, clear area in front of the stage: minimum 6 × 6 m.
Access between the audience area and the stage (stairs or ramp).
Stilts on stage only if the stage is low, with 4 m clear height (ceiling, truss, lights).
The company brings all show materials: instruments, stilts, unicycle, juggling and game props, costumes and make-up.
s2_intro: Preferred option: festival PA and sound engineer. The company brings its own 8 wireless mics. Acoustic option: the band can also play without mics or PA. In that case no sound engineer or power is needed.
s2_p: The festival provides: a PA covering the audience area in front of the stage · desk with 8 free channels · sound engineer · 1 × 230 V socket at FOH for the receivers.
Monitors: not needed; the band plays in front of the PA speakers. Watch for feedback, as the musicians move in front of the PA.
Mic frequencies and models: on request (may vary depending on the artists).
Alternative: on request, the company can bring its own XR18 desk, speakers and engineer (extra cost).
s3: Daytime: nothing needed. At night: general lighting on the square (the festival's).
sets: Sets: 30 minutes each, several during the day. Always a 30-minute break between sets.
s5: The band can't play outdoors in the rain, because of the instruments and microphones. The company can wait for it to stop and play later or another day. Wet ground is fine. Alternative: a large hall at least 5 m high.
s6:
Parking: space for 2 vehicles.
Dressing room: space for 8 people with tables for make-up and changing. The company can bring mirrors and lights.
Meals: 2 meat-free (fish, eggs and dairy are fine) · 6 with no dietary requirements.
s7:
Always possible: tactile visit, 1 hour before the show, after make-up, in a quiet space.
If equipment is available: audio description, hearing loops and vibrating backpacks (fed from the amplified sound) · sign-language interpretation for the games.
